title: Lena and the Drop
author: Coral Underhill
blurb: Dominic Eriksen, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
